required_capabilities: Create Slab (×1); Create Slab Opening (×1); Create Stair (×1); Inspect Project (×1)
instruction: Both floors of the two-storey building, with the same layout, are already created, but no stair and no second-floor slab exist yet. Two steps. (1) Create one straight stair connecting the ground floor to the first floor, placed entirely inside the region x = 11840..13905, y = 3686..9948 (the east corridor), running along the y direction, with valid connections at both storey levels. (2) Create the upper floor's slab (on the level at 4000 mm) using the existing floor type 'Standard Timber-Wood Finish', following the exterior-wall footprint, and cut an opening in it where the stair passes through. Do not modify the existing walls.
